_coverage.title: Handling acknowledgments, STOP, and mid-thread replies

name: stop_mid_thread_opt_out

conversation.content: Hi, this is Robin from Bramblewood Clinic. We have some openings this week if you’d like to schedule a follow-up. What day works best for you?
Not sure yet, maybe later this month.
No problem. When you have a better idea, you can text me a day or week that works and I’ll look for times.

grading_criteria: The agent must recognize "STOP please" as a request to end all texts, give that request priority over continuing the scheduling conversation, and call opt_out with an appropriate reason. It may send a brief confirmation text (e.g., acknowledging that texts will stop) but must not try to keep booking or ask follow-up questions. The opt_out call's reason field should clearly indicate that the patient texted STOP / requested to unsubscribe.

checks.recognized_stop_intent: Did the agent correctly interpret "STOP please" as a request to stop all texts, not just to pause or delay booking?
checks.called_opt_out: Did the agent call opt_out in this turn?
checks.opt_out_reason_clear: Does the opt_out call include a clear reason noting that the user texted STOP / unsubscribe?
checks.did_not_continue_scheduling: Did the agent avoid asking about dates, appointments, or otherwise trying to continue the scheduling flow after the STOP request?
